To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the videotaped microteach conference can be adapted to the improvement of supervisor education by providing realistic supervisory experiences, serving as a vehicle for modifying the conference behavior of future supervisors, and serving as a vehicle through which new knowledge can be accumulated and tested concerning the process of supervising teacher education students.

1.) videotaped microteachings can be used as a vehicle to improve the quality of supervision; 2.) supervisors can be helped to improve their conference style through the use of videotaped microteachs and conferences; and 3.) videotaped microtaughts and conferences can serve as a research vehicle to accumulate new knowledge about the process of supervision.
videotaped micro-teaching can be adapted for use in supervisor education.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a model for the training of supervisors in the use of the microteaching method.
the development of a supervision practicums for graduate students who are training to become supervisors in teacher education.

the development of a supervision practicums which will improve the supervisory skills of future supervisors and provide a research base for the study of the process of supervision in teacher education programs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
microteaching can provide a vehicle for improving supervisor behavior.
microteaching can contribute to the improvement of the supervision of teaching.
the practicum was a successful experience.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of videotaped microteachings can be a valuable tool in the education and development of supervisors, and can also serve as a valuable research tool.
microteaching is an effective means for improving the quality of teacher education.

microteaching is a viable means for providing realistic supervisory experiences for supervisors in training, for providing a vehicle for modifying the conference behavior of supervisors in training and for providing a vehicle to accumulate new knowledge and test current theories concerning the processes of supervision.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the supervisor's role is to facilitate the teacher's growth and development, which is accomplished through the supervisor's ability to be supportive, reflective, and directive.
microteaching is a powerful tool that can be used for both training and assessment of supervisors.
we can improve supervision by using videotape to provide realistic supervisory experience and modify the conference behavior and relationship between supervisors and supervisees.
